absent: Definitions and layouts of mempolicy, nodemask, page, folio, task_struct and preferred node policy beyond the field uses shown
Internals of policy nodemask snapshot, node iteration, current node query and default policy initialization
Allocator, reclaim, compound page and folio conversion mechanics behind frozen page acquisition
Address_space structure, invalidate_lock type and wider locking hierarchy beyond dual ordering
Folio flag indices, waiters bit mechanics and folio to wait bucket mapping function
Wait queue, scheduler sleep, signal, thrashing accounting and memory stall interfaces beyond the call sites shown
Softleaf encoding, migration and device private entry lifecycle and page table lock scope
Page cache xarray, host inode, LRU, private data release, launder and address_space operations contracts
VMA, mm_struct, page table levels, TLB gather, MMU notifier, uprobe and copy on write handling details
Hugetlb state, huge page sizing, reservation, surplus, rmap and userfault marker semantics beyond unmap handling
Writeback initialization and sysctl registration mechanics beyond the single fairness tunable shown

findings.text: Tiered page acquisition is exposed through frozen, counted and folio forming helpers. The frozen helper resolves a policy and node hint, the page helper establishes a counted reference on success, and the folio helper requests compound storage and converts the result to a folio view.

Task policy resolution and interleave target selection are available as helpers. One resolves the effective policy for a task using explicit, per node and system defaults, while the other maps a logical offset to a node within the policy nodemask with fallback to the current node.

Paired helpers acquire and release invalidation exclusion for up to two address spaces. Acquisition tolerates absent mappings and a repeated mapping, while release mirrors that tolerance without ordering dependence.

Public folio synchronization covers sleeping on a flag bit in uninterruptible and killable forms, waiting on a softleaf lock with page table lock handoff, completing a read with optional validity marking, and clearing plus waiting on a private auxiliary flag in plain and killable forms.

Cache and address teardown is exposed through folio invalidation with unmapping, single folio mapping removal, batched virtual range zapping with notifier bracketing, and huge page range unmapping with reservation handling.

Boot initialization prepares the folio wait infrastructure, writeback support and virtual memory controls. It initializes every wait bucket, delegates writeback setup, and registers the page lock fairness control under the virtual memory namespace.

Interleave placement distributes consecutive offsets across usable nodes in nodemask order. The position is the offset modulo the usable count, with an empty mask yielding the current node instead of a mask walk.

Preferred many allocation prefers a supplied node set before falling back system wide. The preferred attempt suppresses warnings and disables direct reclaim and mandatory success, while the fallback preserves caller flags and searches without a mask restriction.

Frozen allocation defaults to the system policy and adopts the task policy only outside interrupt context without a strict local node constraint. It always uses a non interleaved index together with the current node as hint.

Effective task policy follows explicit assignment first, then an initialized per node preferred entry when the current node is valid, and finally the system default. Uninitialized early boot entries are skipped.

Counted pages derive from frozen pages by adding a reference only on success, and folios derive from counted compound pages through a remappable conversion. Failure propagates as a null result without side effects.
A header fallback defines mapping folio removal as a no operation, contrasting with the full unmapping implementation available elsewhere, indicating configuration dependent selection.

Dual mapping exclusion is deadlock free through address ordering. The lower addressed mapping is acquired first with ordinary semantics and the distinct higher one with nested semantics, tolerating nulls and identity, while release is idempotent over the same tolerance.

Folio bit waiting serializes waiter publication under the bucket irq lock. The waiters indication is set before the final synchronous attempt, insertion happens only on failure, and completion flags travel from waker to waiter with release acquire ordering.

Softleaf locked waiting transfers exclusion from page table lock to wait bucket. Queue publication completes before the page table lock is released, and folio validity across the handoff relies on the holder retaining a reference until removal under the same lock.

Folio detachment holds host and page cache exclusion together while confirming cleanliness and removing the folio. List management and optional free callback occur after page cache release, with failure paths releasing both locks and reporting busy.

Mapping unmapping coordinates reverse mapping and huge page exclusion. Single folio removal uses read side reverse mapping exclusion around the mapped check, huge range teardown asserts write side exclusion on entry, and last anon unmap reservation decisions serialize under the global huge page irq lock with a private lock check.

Folio waiting uses a fixed aligned array of wait buckets whose size is a power of two derived from a bit count. All buckets are initialized at boot and shared by folio waits through a folio to bucket association.

Folio waits distinguish three intents. Exclusive waits acquire the bit with possible waker handoff, shared waits observe clearance while retaining a reference, and dropping waits release the reference before sleeping without a post wake check.

Fairness control is a single virtual memory tunable for page lock handoff aggressiveness. It is an integer with a zero lower bound, world readable and owner writable, handled as a bounded integer vector.

Folio bit waiting combines a fast acquisition attempt with queued sleeping and race retry. Unfairness counts down exclusive attempts before requesting waker side acquisition, sleep honors the requested task state and interruption, and exclusive losers requeue while completion is signaled through distinct woken and done indications.

Wake matching filters by folio and bit identity before acting. Exclusive waiters stop traversal on contention, custom handoff attempts atomic acquisition and records done on success, and successful wakes mark woken, wake the task and detach the entry, reporting exclusivity to control traversal.

Read completion requires a locked folio without prior validity on success. It always releases the locked indication, adds validity only on success, and wakes the locked bit only when waiters were recorded, with a build constraint keeping validity within the low byte.

Auxiliary private state completes by requiring the flag, clearing it with unlock ordering, waking its bit and releasing a reference. Waiters loop until the flag clears, with a killable form that aborts and propagates interruption on signal.

Invalidation with unmapping enforces a locked folio that ends unmapped. It tolerates an initially mapped folio by unmapping first, then requires successful cleaning, stable mapping association, releasable private state and sustained cleanliness to detach and free, otherwise reporting busy.

Range zapping branches on mapping kind under notifier bracketing and resource accounting. Empty ranges return early, huge mappings delegate to huge teardown with begin end coordination and intermediate resource flushing, while ordinary mappings walk top level table entries within the requested virtual interval.

Huge unmapping resolves each huge slot to absence, sharing, empty, special or present handling. Absence and sharing skip to the next huge boundary, empty slots clear without accounting, special non present entries clear or retain a userfault marker per drop intent, and present entries clear with translation removal, dirtiness propagation, optional marker retention, accounting and reverse map removal plus conditional anon reservation restore.

Lost wakeup is avoided by marking waiters before the last synchronous check under the bucket lock. Flags are observed with acquire semantics after setting an interruptible state, termination honors pending signals, and final success is judged only after queue removal because a wake may land between signal check and removal, leaving a stale waiters mark for a later wake.

Exclusive acquisition bounds spinning on contention through a tunable unfairness budget. Exhausting the budget switches to waker granted acquisition, preventing starvation when many waiters compete for the same bit.

Opportunistic and forced cache removal guard against data loss and use after remap. Dropbehind acts only on clean unmapped folios with the hint set, while forced removal refuses busy when cleaning fails, the mapping changed, private state remains or dirtiness reappeared under exclusion.

Huge teardown assumes huge alignment of both range ends and exclusive reverse mapping access. Per virtual area unmapping clamps the requested folio index interval to the overlap with each area and translates that overlap to addresses, skipping unmapped associations and honoring copy on write skipping plus marker dropping for single folio invalidation.
Folio wait bucket geometry uses a width of eight bits for a total of two hundred fifty six buckets.
Page lock unfairness control defaults to five, lives under virtual memory controls as page_lock_unfairness, enforces a lower bound of zero and uses permission mode 0644.
